_readme: TOKYO -- the planet's buildings over the bay. The scene says what is in it and where the eye
starts; it names no place for the world to stand about: the wave bank's chart floats to the
ground under the eye (WaterBankLayer::Chart), so the same scene can fly on to anywhere.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/tokyo.json
FLY: W A S D move, Q / E down / up, hold the right mouse button to look.
